$comment: P02 dependency and provider pins. Owned by B-0, the sole writer of the root lock for Gate B. Sibling of docs/program/FOUNDATION_LOCK.json, which owns P01.

decisions_applied.OD-01: PDF text extraction: a permissively licensed extractor giving per-character boxes, plus a separate page-count and encryption probe. Copyleft blocked.

pdfplumber.purpose: text extraction with per-character geometry; x0/x1/top/bottom, fontname and size per character, runs grouped into lines

pypdf.purpose: the separate envelope probe OD-01 requires: page count and encryption, answered without parsing content

rejected_candidates.PyMuPDF/fitz: AGPL. OD-01 blocks a copyleft library until the owner rules otherwise. Not evaluated further.
rejected_candidates.pypdfium2 as the direct extractor: Scored 12/12 on the corpus oracle and offers per-character boxes, so it was a genuine alternative. Rejected on API fit: pdfplumber's per-character dicts and line grouping map directly onto B2's block index with page, bounding box and text-span anchors, whereas pypdfium2 is lower level. It enters the lock anyway as a pdfplumber dependency, BSD-3-Clause and Apache-2.0.

models.$comment: Recorded here so B3's cost ceiling and P4-OPS-01's cost measurement read one source. Rates are the 2026-06-24 cached rate table, per USD per million tokens.

provider_configuration.$comment: READ THIS BEFORE ADDING A NAME TO .env. Provider configuration is deliberately NOT in the lane .env, and B-0 did not add one.
provider_configuration.finding: The B-0 brief asked for additive .env.example names for provider credentials, provider mode and the cost ceiling. The Makefile refuses them. load_env enforces a strict allowlist of exactly the fifteen names FF-01 section 3 freezes, and its comment states the intent: .env configures this lane's services and 'does not carry tool options, credentials for other systems, or anything that selects what code runs'. PROVIDER_MODE is precisely something that selects what code runs, which is the case the guard exists to refuse.
provider_configuration.resolution: Provider configuration is application-layer, read by the application from its own process environment at runtime, never from the lane .env and never through make. The credential is an injected secret per FF-01 section 2.9 and is never committed.

names_the_application_reads.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: injected secret; never written to a file in this repository
names_the_application_reads.AUDITMANAGER_PROVIDER_MODE: live | recorded. Recorded is the default for automated suites under OD-13.
names_the_application_reads.AUDITMANAGER_RUN_COST_CEILING_USD: per-run ceiling; exceeding it raises cost_budget_exceeded (OD-03)

provider_configuration.owner_action_if_this_is_wrong: Putting provider configuration into .env means extending FROZEN_ENV_NAMES, which is an FF-01 section 3 freeze-break and needs an explicit break record. It is not something a pin session may do, and B-0 did not do it.

acceptance_evidence.corpus_oracle: The pinned extractor recovers 12 of 12 manifest quotations from fixtures/synthetic/ar/ar_baseline.pdf at their declared pages, all 12 wholly within a single line, which is the resolution contract expected_issues.json declares. Run with .venv/bin/python on the widened lock.
acceptance_evidence.per_character_geometry: 535 characters on page 2, each with x0, x1, top and bottom.

negative_fixtures.encrypted.pdf: probe reports ENCRYPTED; extraction raises rather than returning empty text
negative_fixtures.image_only.pdf: probe reads 2 pages; extraction yields 0 characters, distinguishable from a parse failure
negative_fixtures.too_many_pages.pdf: probe reports 31 pages, refused before extraction
negative_fixtures.oversize.pdf: 26.0 MiB, refused on size before parsing

acceptance_evidence.copyleft_audit: 44 installed distributions inspected across the full closure; zero copyleft-suspect licences.

contract_to_gate_b: Every Gate B session consumes these pins and may not add or upgrade a root dependency. A session needing one stops and reports it.
